messages:
cara: Quick sync: planning a compact base-image rebuild & re-sign next Tue 09:00 PT. Need RBAC for ephemeral signer, audit sink confirmation, and a short canary plan.
jun: Got it. Which KMS key will we use? ops-oncall wants the principal list for pager config.
oliver: Use projects/prod-kms/cryptoKeys/base-image-key. Currently ci-signer has access. We should add an ephemeral SA instead of reusing CI.
remy: Ephemeral SA sounds safer. Propose kms-rebuild-signer-<id> with 48h TTL and only roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier on that key.
cara: Agreed. Also switch pipeline to KMS keyVersion signing (no local private keys). We'll block signing until vuln-scan passes.
jun: I'll open the Terraform PR. snippet will create service account and a google_kms_crypto_key_iam_binding.
oliver: I'll review for a condition expression limiting to the key resource and add a cloudasset export to capture IAM change.
remy: Audit retention: forward key use logs to sec-audit GCS with at least 1y retention for provenance; admin activity 365d. Security signoff required.
ops-oncall: Runtime checks before canary: image-compat (glibc matrix), seccomp/syscall profile, no setuid, and runtime-health job. Canary rollback policy: auto rollback on health regressions.
security-bot: POLICY UPDATE: IAM change triggers /policies/kms-signing approval. Attach checklist: /policies/kms-signing/approval-checklist.md
jun: Terraform snippet I'll put in PR:
```
resource "google_service_account" "kms_rebuild_signer" {
  account_id = "kms-rebuild-signer-1719"
}
resource "google_kms_crypto_key_iam_binding" "signer" {
  crypto_key_id = var.base_image_key
  role = "roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier"
  members = ["serviceAccount:${google_service_account.kms_rebuild_signer.email}"]
}
```
oliver: Ping me on PR; I'll add condition to binding to restrict to sign action and specific keyVersion.
remy: Pipeline must upload cosign bundle + in-toto statement to gs://rebuild-provenance/<id>/ and trigger sbom-indexer. Make those objects immutable.
cara: Canary plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 2h, with 30min stabilization each step. Metrics: p99 latency, error rate <0.5%, startup time.
ops-oncall: I'll schedule rollout window and rotate ephemeral SA before the job. Also ensure previous signed image remains available for instant rollback.
jun: PR opened: https://git.redwood/sre/infra/pulls/438 1 - includes SA, IAM binding, and cloudasset export.
oliver: Reviewed, left comments on condition and naming.
remy: Add vuln-scan + quick manual triage to block signing. Record findings in JIRA KMS-SIGN-1719.
cara: Thanks. I'll gather approvals tomorrow 08:30 PT and post back. :thumbsup:
